QUOTE: "inside the library, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` is just `x`, so the library reads and writes its own fields directly" and "the default expansion is `private_##member`, so `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(alg)` becomes `ctx->private_alg`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer contrasts code that defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` (plain member names) with ordinary consumers of the public headers (renamed `private_` names).
